name: keeping the books
from: 2026-10-02 observed source state: A books substrate and unit-value writer exist, but current portfolio coverage is largely unpopulated, conventional monetary events lack their own canonical journal, and no firm-wide allocation denomination is settled.
to: Books kept in a settled denomination, recording value created and value captured separately per unit, so an allocation the investment review board states is a number something can be checked against.
cost: Settling the allocation denomination, populating sourced unit-value entries, and adding conventional monetary event coverage without collapsing money into the win-win value ledger or house-resource measures.
otherwise: The investment review board's allocations remain scales with nothing to count them in, and 'accounts must match reality' has no accounts to check.
